Every element of the event was incredibly thoughtful and seamlessly executed, making it feel like you had stepped straight into a Victoria’s Secret fashion show fantasy. The details were next-level—from the greeters in custom pajamas, to my daughter’s lit-up wings and custom stage for her runway moment, to the stunning photo booth with a flower laced swing and real feathers for added drama. The merch station looked like an actual Victoria’s Secret store, the bar featured a striking winged centerpiece, and the feathered dance floor became a focal point of the night. Signature pink-striped accents were everywhere—on the games, activity stations, tables—tying it all together into one cohesive, stunning experience.

What truly sets Nicole apart is her ability to elevate every moment, including the ones that happen before the party even begins. The temple director personally shared to the congregation that he had never seen such beautiful decor and floral arrangements at a service—it set a tone of elegance and wow factor that carried through the entire celebration.

Nicole and her team are not only incredibly talented designers, but also true professionals who are incredibly easy and fun to work with and who take pride in perfection. They anticipate details you didn’t even know to think about and execute with precision, creativity, and care.
